panels.shot: The flooded tunnel, blue-green. Kalt floats face-down among broken glass and drifting jellyfish. Above, through the broken roof, the hero climbs out onto a catwalk, soaked.

lines.text: The sea took her back. It always collects.

panels.shot: The dark lobby. A payphone on the wall rings. Wet footprints pass it. The whale skeleton above.

lines.text: A phone rang behind me. For once, I let it ring.

panels.shot: Exterior. Mags's coupe speeds along the sea wall in the storm. A red laser dot slides across the windscreen.
Close-up. Shattered windscreen, a bullet hole. Mags slumps, holding her bloody shoulder. Nero barks wildly in the back seat.

lines.text: They didn't aim at me. They aimed at what I had left.

panels.shot: The hero drives with one hand, holding Mags with the other. A red neon cross ahead: St. Cecilia Hospital.

lines.text: St. Cecilia. Patron saint of music. Of course it belonged to the Choir.
